$comment: Platform stacks on glados (observability ones live in r2pen2/observability). Each folder is installed file by file into `dest` (files that aren't in the repo are left alone, e.g. traefik/dynamic/billing-blocks.yml, which WL-Universe's site-billing writes). `envFile` is passed to docker compose --env-file. `restart`: containers restarted when a mounted (non-compose) file changes; omit for configs the service watches itself. kind "systemd": host files installed to absolute paths, then the units are enabled and restarted.
